name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private six-control Evidence Lane with atomic host-aware Boot, generalized Source Intake, universal Git/CAS brains, candidate-only sector overlays, exact-APPROVE Fuse, and fresh-host State Travel.

interface.shortDescription: Run six governed controls over universal evidence brains.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane exposes Boot, Rollback, Build, Refresh, Mode, and Source Intake after root /evi, with conditional State Travel only for a sealed accepted handoff. Boot atomically verifies locked ENV15/UOP15 Flash and routes durable local versus configured remote storage fail-closed. Source Intake auto-detects all eighteen lanes and Project Engulf while Mode accepts ordered known intersections and explicit custom schemas. Git history, content-addressed chunks, lane SQLite/FTS/MMD/DOT, candidate-only project-sector overlays, and visible secret-redacted ChatLineage remain outside accepted truth until exact APPROVE invokes Fuse.
defaultPrompt: Run /evi, atomically Boot plus locked ENV/UOP Flash, and show the six controls.
Use /evi-source-intake with ordered sources and auto-detection or exact lane overrides.
Use /evi-refresh to seal an unaccepted candidate, show six-way HIL, and wait for my exact decision.
